Handed to the team · No confirmed date after Nov 14 passed. I can't promise Nov 30 without the team.

Hi Siraz,

I can't give you a firm yes on November 30 yet, and I'd rather be straight with you than guess. Your order Shop···· was due to ship on November 14, and that date has passed. You're right to keep asking.

Here's where it stands today. Your Power K. is set aside for you at our Tennessee warehouse. The US batch of B30s is arriving there and being checked in, and your B30 is the only piece still to come. The warehouse ships the oldest orders first, and you ordered on September 12, so you're near the front of the line. You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I've asked the team to confirm whether your B30 will ship by November 30. Someone will pick up your ticket and reply in this thread with an answer. Your tracking number will also come by email as soon as the box leaves the warehouse.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
